title: Pay coherence at each causal gap rather than only peak memory
statement: At the specified L gaps, every classical-at-gaps receiver with arbitrary K-dimensional source code, unlimited classical records and arbitrary final recovery has F_e<=min(1,2^L/K), hence half-diamond error>=max(0,1-2^L/K). The GF4 five-gap phase code retains six logical qubits in ten source qubits and corrects one completed coherent location fault. For quantum cut dimensions D_j the exact preservation bound is k<=L+sum_j log2 D_j.

requires: The exact L-pair source-field contact and actual Bell receiver with no supplied field preparation label/purification or protected bypass
Completed admitted fault locations, fixed acquired frames/source code and implemented source syndrome/recovery; count every returning coherent bath
provides: A source-reported internally accepted exact conditional coding/causal-memory separation
assumptions: One receiver qubit across a gap is not the Bell-analysis processing peak
Known Bell field, avoided optional contact, extra source contacts or a returning uncounted bath change the comparator
The fixed erasure primitive does not implement an arbitrary nontrivial logical gate
costs: Finite10/6 construction:20 source-field contacts,5 Bell CNOT/5 H/10 readouts,44 CNOT+1 SWAP encoder and inverse decoder,18 syndrome contacts plus preparation/reset/feedforward
Closed logical-CZ full ideal netlist ends at recovered encoded outputs:316 bus contacts,198 H,14 source qubits and6 bus reset/readout cycles; unencoding additional
Weak-noise bound requires all-input interaction norms eta_j, not marginal infidelity; extensive-radius code search/decoding and dense checks may be expensive
contract.units: Logical/physical qubits, actual cut dimensions and half-diamond error; no duration/energy conversion or physical fault rate.
contract.obstruction: Peak register size alone omits how many boundaries require coherence and which source-error characters faults can expose.

evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: The delivered completed internal acceptance is preserved at its stated mathematical/model scope. The fixed source/field erasure operation, arbitrary common field and correlated logical/reference/bath inputs, source-independent completed fault support and actual record interface govern. Returning quantum baths count as physical cut memory. Capture, source encoding/storage/control, syndrome extraction/reset and leakage/loss continuation are acquired or separately bounded. This is a conditional operation separation, not a physical threshold or advantage over conventional fault-tolerant computing. Seven direct transversal CZ gates beat the bus when those ports are supplied. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
